div.head: IV Eg 1a
div.ab: He beþohte ⁊ asmeade þæt godcunde be woruldgewunan:
He beðohte ⁊ asmeade þæt godcunde be woruldgewunan:
Ideo dignum memoria proferens exemplar ait:
He beþohte ⁊ asmeade þæt godcunde be woruldgewunan:
Er betrachtete und erwog das göttliche [Walten] gemäss weltlichem Gewohnheitsrecht:
He considered and weighed the divine [order] by analogy with secular custom:
He has been thinking over and considering the ways of God by an analogy with human actions:
He has pondered and considered the ways of God by comparison with worldly usage:
div.note: Liebermann would supply ‘gerihta’ or ‘teoðunga’ or a synonym after ‘godcunde’.; BF: added from Gesetze I p. 206, October 2026 (MS C (Latin)); O: corrected against Gesetze I, October 2026 (was “(Latin version of C)”, now “∅ (moved to BF)”)
